extraction_supporting_text.cases: Blood donors to the Janus serum data bank in Norway, who later developed prostate cancer, were matched to blood donors without prostate cancer (141 matched sets); the proportional level of fatty acids measured before diagnosis in the donors' serum was examined.
extraction_supporting_text.effect_size: There was no clear association between the risk effect of total omega-3 and total omega-6 fatty acids.
extraction_supporting_text.comparison: Increasing risk for prostate cancer was found with increasing quartiles of palmitoleic, palmitic and alpha-linolenic acid.
extraction_supporting_text.design: The risk of later prostate cancer was analysed by conditional logistic regression.
extraction_supporting_text.timing: the proportional level of fatty acids measured before diagnosis in the donors' serum was examined
extraction_supporting_text.continent: Blood donors to the Janus serum data bank in Norway
